description: Intermediate conclusions as boolean slots p.<name> (format 0.3): each is a card the player can conclude and then cite. Some are what a character knows (knowledge tracks in states.json).

propositions.text: A stable-boy sleeps alone in the stable every night.
Brown's only hope of mercy is to produce the horse safe.
Someone raised the alarm at the stable in the night.
Hunter saw his supper being drugged.
source: would undoubtedly detect it, and would probably eat no more

propositions.text: The gypsies would have left at news of trouble, whoever did the crime.
